evals.name: cold-start-quote-drafting
evals.prompt: Quiero automatizar esto en este repo usando el use-case builder de Forjate; llamá al caso quote-drafting. Somos un taller metalúrgico de 25 personas: los clientes piden presupuestos por un formulario web (pieza, material, cantidades, plazo y a veces un plano en PDF) y hoy el dueño los cotiza a mano con una planilla de precios de material y horas de máquina, y tarda dos o tres días en contestar. Quiero un agente que arme el borrador del presupuesto con la planilla y que un vendedor lo revise y lo apruebe antes de mandarlo. No me hagas preguntas, estas son las respuestas: todo en español; sin context packs; pide el dueño y aprueba el dueño, revisan los dos vendedores; unos 120 pedidos por mes; la planilla de precios es un CSV que actualiza el dueño cada mes y no hay ERP; la métrica es el tiempo de respuesta al cliente, hoy 48 horas, objetivo 4 horas, sin presupuestos por debajo del costo; ningún presupuesto sale sin aprobación de un vendedor; los datos son comerciales confidenciales (precios, márgenes, nombre y mail del cliente), pueden ir a un proveedor de modelos externo bajo un acuerdo que no entrene con ellos, sin requisito de residencia; no es un ambiente regulado; presupuesto 150 USD por mes; por ahora quiero llegar a Walk (crawl y walk); sin aislamiento entre tenants. Llevalo de punta a punta en esta sesión: brief, packs, plan de etapas (dalo por aprobado), todos los expertos que el plan corre, el pase de consistencia, la consolidación de gates, el scaffold de la app y el ensamblado, todo bajo k8s/overlays/usecases/<nombre>/, validado con plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py, y terminá con el reporte de revisión. No levantes un cluster: quien califica esta corrida levanta Crawl con ./scripts/ephemeral/ephemeral.sh.
evals.expected_output: A complete use case from a problem that is not on disk: brief (es, confidential, egress allowed, crawl+walk), plan, every expert record with the governance posture, gates.yaml, app/ and scaffold.yaml, usecase.yaml, root and Walk overlays that build, a report naming every open question; ephemeral.sh up passes the verify Job.

assertions.text: egress to a model provider allowed, as answered
no quote leaves without a person: writes at Walk need approval (or the agent writes nothing)
every expert the plan runs wrote its record
assertions.cmd: .venv/bin/python -c "import yaml,pathlib,sys; u=pathlib.Path('k8s/overlays/usecases/quote-drafting/.builder'); p=yaml.safe_load((u/'stage-plan.yaml').read_text()); m=[e['role'] for e in p['spec']['experts'] if e.get('run') and not (u/'decisions'/(e['role']+'.yaml')).exists()]; print('missing:', m); sys.exit(1 if m else 0)"

assertions.text: validate.py passes: every record and gates.yaml validate, no cross-record error
the plan caps Crawl at assistive autonomy

assertions.expr: all(setting('execution_bounds', s) for s in stages if st(s).get('choice') is not None) and setting('intent_validation', 'crawl') in ('schema', 'policy-judge')

assertions.expr: all(setting('kill_switch', s) is not None for s in stages if st(s).get('choice') is not None)
assertions.text: security states the kill switch at every stage it plans
quality states audit artifacts and evaluation dimensions at Crawl

the root overlay builds and passes kubeconform
the review report names every open question of every record
ephemeral.sh up passes the verify Job (Crawl proof, G-Q-1); seconds in crawl-up-seconds.txt

evals.name: cold-start-invoice-intake
evals.prompt: I want to automate this in this repo with the Forjate use-case builder; call the use case invoice-intake. Supplier invoices arrive as PDF attachments in a shared mailbox. Someone reads each one, types supplier, amount, date and PO number into the ERP, and flags mismatches against the purchase order. We want this automated with a human approving anything that does not match. Do not ask me questions, these are the answers: everything in English; context pack regulated-corp (context-packs/examples/regulated-corp); finance ops asks for it, the AP clerk approves exceptions, the CFO approves the stages; the systems are Odoo, over its REST API, the system of record for about 500 open purchase orders and the payables, and the shared IMAP mailbox, about 300 invoices a month; the data is financial, bank account numbers appear on invoices, it must stay in the EU and must not go to an external model provider; open standards are required; it is a regulated environment; budget 300 USD a month; the metric is invoices posted to the ERP without manual typing, today 0%, target 80% straight-through with 0 wrong amounts; I want to reach production (crawl, walk and run); the agent proposes and a person approves anything that does not match; it is a regulated decision and a high-impact action; logical isolation from other tenants. Take it end to end in this session: brief, packs, stage plan (treat it as approved), every expert the plan runs, the consistency pass, gates consolidation, the app scaffold and the assembly, everything under k8s/overlays/usecases/<name>/, validated with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py, and end with the review report. Do not start a cluster: whoever grades this run brings Crawl up with ./scripts/ephemeral/ephemeral.sh.

evals.name: cold-start-support-copilot
evals.prompt: I want to automate this in this repo with the Forjate use-case builder; call the use case support-copilot. Customers write to a Telegram group with questions about their orders and subscriptions. Two agents answer by hand, looking things up in the admin panel. We want a bot that answers the common questions itself, keeps the conversation context, and hands anything involving refunds or cancellations to a human with the full context attached. Do not ask me questions, these are the answers: everything in English; no context packs; customer success asks for it and the head of CS approves; the two support agents receive the escalations; the systems are the Telegram Bot API and the orders API, the system of record for about 40k customers' orders and subscriptions; about 200 chat messages a day; the data is PII; model providers outside the cluster are allowed; not regulated; budget 150 USD a month; the metric is the share of conversations resolved without a human, today 0%, target 60% within 3 months with escalations carrying the full context; crawl and walk for now; the bot answers on its own and escalates (semi-autonomous); it is customer-facing; no tenant isolation. Take it end to end in this session: brief, packs, stage plan (treat it as approved), every expert the plan runs, the consistency pass, gates consolidation, the app scaffold and the assembly, everything under k8s/overlays/usecases/<name>/, validated with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py, and end with the review report. Do not start a cluster: whoever grades this run brings Crawl up with ./scripts/ephemeral/ephemeral.sh.
